proposals.before: Seven years later, in the sixth month, Emperor Wen passed away.
proposals.after: In the seventh year of the Later era, in the sixth month, Emperor Wen passed away.
proposals.reason: 後七年 denotes Emperor Wen's 后元七年 (seventh year of his Later era), not 'seven years later' after an earlier event.

proposals.before: Judge Hui Shuo and his wives and children according to the law.'
proposals.after: Sentence Hui Shuo and his wives and children according to the law.
proposals.reason: 論 means to judge/sentence the offenders; 'Judge' is not Hui Shuo's title or name.

decisions.reason: 後七年 here is the seventh year of Emperor Wen's Later era (后元), not an elapsed span after a prior event; the proposed wording restores that reign-year sense and matches 六月，文帝崩.

decisions.after: Sentence Hui Shuo and his wives and children according to the law.'
decisions.reason: 論...如法 is a legal imperative to sentence the offenders, so sentence-initial 'Judge' wrongly invites a title reading; the proposal's verb is right, but the closing edict quote mark after 如法 must be kept.
